content.title: Abbott Falls Most in Nearly 24 Years on Formula Pricing Stumble
content.summary: In the fourth quarter, Abbott’s sales were $11.5 billion, below the average analyst estimate of $11.8 billion.  Nutrition sales were $1.9 billion, far short of the average analyst estimate of $2.19 billion.  “We are transitioning our nutrition business to place greater emphasis on sustainable volume growth, which affects the first half of the year but better positions the business for longer-term success,” Chief Executive Officer Robert Ford said in a statement to Bloomberg News.
